scenario_title: Dropped index, sequential scans at peak
title: Latency and timeouts on api-gateway

detection.alert: api-gateway: p99 latency > 2 s for 5 min

impact: Requests slowed down and a share of them timed out on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-03-09 14:20-18:40: api-gateway: 264 of 367 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-09 14:20 and 2026-03-09 18:40 UTC (peak error ratio 0.92 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 28.121 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Deploy {version_to} of {svc} dropped index ix_servers_tenant on meta-db.servers (it looked unused on the replica); the hot query fell back to sequential scans and timed out at peak.
_templates.remediation: Recreate ix_servers_tenant CONCURRENTLY on meta-db; roll back {svc} if needed; check index usage on the primary before dropping.

culprit.diff:
@@ -1,2 +1,3 @@ migration
 -- index cleanup (storage cost)
+DROP INDEX IF EXISTS ix_servers_tenant;  -- unused according to pg_stat_user_indexes (replica only)
 COMMIT;

rca.macro: Deploy v3.3.0 of cloud-api dropped index ix_servers_tenant on meta-db.servers (it looked unused on the replica); the hot query fell back to sequential scans and timed out at peak.
rca.remediation: Recreate ix_servers_tenant CONCURRENTLY on meta-db; roll back cloud-api if needed; check index usage on the primary before dropping.

action_items: Add a regression test covering migration (cloud-api/db/migrations/V84__cleanup_indexes.sql).
Alert on the error signature `GET <*> <*> <*> target=cloud-api`.
